avis.texte: This product feels like little tiny needles are puncturing your skin, it feels oddly satisfying. It definitely has cleared my skin. My skin has never looked this good. I would definitely recommend this in your skincare routine along with the VT reeder 100 and PDRN 100 for daily use.

avis.titre: Love this for a few years now!
avis.texte: My go-to little helper for my dry skin needs! I feel the result right away and truly love it!

I tried the 300 earlier this year, and it's not a miracle product where you'll see results in one night, however, with consistent use along with good products tailored for your skin (everyone's skin is different, so always try on products before using them on your whole face) can go a long way. Trust the process!

I turn 50 this year and my moisturizer seemed to just sit on top of my skin lately. I started using reedle shot a few times a week and I can see my skin drinking up the moisturizer, lines and puffiness are lessened, my skin tone is more even. I use less makeup and everyone says I'm glowing. Love, love, love!!

I am absolutely in love with this product! I bought it on a whim during a sale around Black Friday and have been using it regularly. The prickle and tingle are definitely an experience, so be aware that it may feel a little bit like fiberglass being rubbed on your skin. It is never painful, just a bit uncomfortable for a few minutes, especially if I layer it with my hyaluronic essence. My skin looks absolutely flawless after using it, especially the next day. It is like there is a filter on my skin, even when I don't wear makeup. I am pretty acne-prone, but there have been no reactions or breakouts that I have noticed since I started using it. I am considering using some of the other products in the line because of how great it is. I can think of literally nothing I dislike about it.

It tingled my skin the first time I used it, but after continued use, it doesn't really tingle anymore. It helps my skin absorb skincare products very well, and I can see the difference. I love using it before applying a facial mask. If you are a beginner, start with 100 or a lower level. I would definitely buy it again.
This worked on me. My skin texture has improved over months, I've been hearing that my skin has gone so much better!

I've been using this product as directed for 4 mos & don't notice anything different about my skin. I still have a few blackheads that come & go & my cheeks aren't any softer than they were when I first started using the product. I'm just glad I got this on sale because it was literally a waste of money.

This seems like a gimmicky product. I dont know about all those improvements all those influencers had, but I didn't see any changes in my skin at all. I went through an entire bottle and it didnt do anything. Those people are full of bologna, or being paid to push this product. They were probably pushing it because it was preparing to go into Ulta. Giving the brand some recognition before it went into Ulta. Kinda funny, we never hear them talk about it anymore, nor see any of them still using it. The hype has died down, and once again they tricked the people. Save your money. This does nothing

This product boosted absorption and results of my other products. Helps even out my over all tone. I did not know this was a hyped product until reading other reviews, i had first tried their face mask while abroad and was happy to see the line in US stores as well. I would recommend nevertheless

You need to get this right now! I was afraid to try at first. It feels like little prickly needles when you first put it on but it's not as intense as I thought it would be. My skin has never looked better at 64 years! I am so pleased with the performance of this product I would highly recommend it.

Eh. Skip this product. I've gone through 2 bottles and it did nothing for me. Also, don't listen to all the influencers talking about how this stuff hurts or you need a high pain tolerance. Totally overhyped. Barely any sensation with both bottles.

avis.titre: the innovation in these products is great!
avis.texte: yes it does feel prickly but the results are worth it and amazing

I started off with 100. And now I purchase the 300. I use it every 3 days. Then I apply my p d r n rejourn Gold bottle for mature skin. The next morning my skin looks amazing. I highly recommend vt shot!

I was very excited to try this product and was even a bit nervous because I thought it might sting or feel like small needle pricks. However, I get neither of those sensations, in fact, I can barely feel anything at all! It really just feels like a serum with a hint of warmth then it goes away. Any "pricks" I feel are like a distant itch. I used this product morning and night and my skin had zero change. It did not make my other skincare more or less effective. This product feels very gimmicky and I will not repurchase. For reference, I have fair and reactive skin. I had zero reaction from this product, not even the slight flushing or redness it says may occur.
Already bought again. The tingle is weird the first few times but it is addictive!!

I use this as directed (every three days) and omg its so good! I feel a huge difference in the tecture of my skin, its more plump, more glowy, and more smooth. I also feel like it does help the products you go on top with to absorb better. The needle feeling isnt bad at all. I use my regular rountine after i do this serum which includes vitamin C, glycolic acid, niacinimide, retinol, etc. and i havent had any irritation. Been using for about 3 weeks now every Sunday and Thursday.
Ok i went straight to the level 300 and it does feel tingly/scratchy when you put it on but nothing unbearable. I feel like my skin is looking more glowy and bright after 1 week of use
Great for any akin, start with a little and build up over time but its such a great product

Im always blind buying products just to try out which is probably the best and worst idea for my skin lol . I do tend to have acne prone skin , combination , and have a pore / texture problem. Now im not going to lie to yall and say omg holy grail my acne disappeared ! … this is literally only my second time applying the product. I feel glowy in the morning , my face is smoother to the touch and almost feels like i have absorbed my serum a bit better. My skin feels hydrated & im excited for the future results. There is a slight tingle sensation but no burning is followed . Its more of a rekaxing feel and it didnt bother me throughout the night. Will most likely repurchase this producy if the glowy glass skin persists.
